greeting: Good morning, Rick! Happy Sunday, grab a coffee before the Cowboys kick off this afternoon.

items.title: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
items.note: The Nvidia shakeup keeps rolling. More than 115,000 people, including thousands of Nvidia employees and Elon Musk, signed a petition asking the board to bring back ousted CEO Jensen Huang while an investigation plays out.

items.title: SpaceX successfully catches Starship after launch for the first time
items.note: SpaceX caught the top half of its giant Starship rocket with the launch tower's arms in South Texas, a first. The booster wasn't so lucky, though, and ended up exploding near the Gulf.

items.title: Got an iPhone Duo? These 9 settings make it easier to use
items.note: Apple's foldable iPhone uses Touch ID instead of Face ID, and these simple tweaks, like registering extra fingerprints, make it a lot easier to live with. Handy if you're eyeing one or already have one.

items.title: Early Black Friday Apple deals: AirPods, AirTag 2, MacBook Air, Apple Pencil, Mac mini, more
items.note: Black Friday prices are showing up early, including AirTag 2 for $17.50, $50 off AirPods Pro 3, and big drops on MacBook Air. A good list to skim if you're starting holiday shopping.

items.title: Tesla opens Cybercab pre-orders 'for personal use,' with geo restrictions and a $299 monthly fee
items.note: Tesla's self-driving, no-steering-wheel Cybercab is up for pre-order at $29,990, but delivery is only in a few Texas cities and it costs $299 a month to run. Even Musk says that fee is too high.

items.title: How to get better results from Google Gemini
items.note: Simple tips for getting better answers out of Google's AI helper, mostly by giving it clear, detailed instructions and connecting the apps you already use.

items.title: Transportation secretary blames 'routine' equipment upgrade for grounding flights nationwide
items.note: Friday's nationwide flight ground stop came down to a cable upgrade where one overloaded router swamped a key FAA system. A good reminder to check your flight status before heading to the airport.

items.title: This Sony patent would add a credit card reader to your PlayStation controller
items.note: Sony has an idea for a PlayStation controller that grabs payment info from your nearby phone, so buying games takes one less step. Convenient, though maybe a little too easy on the wallet.
